fact: UNDP says it deployed country-hosted AI compute capacity in Zambia under its AI Infrastructure Activation programme.
UNDP's programme procured and deployed country-hosted GPU compute in Zambia.

INFRATEL Corporation Limited advertised on the Zambia Public Procurement Authority e-GP platform an open national tender (INFRATEL-CAPEX-2026-029/35) for the supply, installation and commissioning of 150TB storage engines and an AI/ML GPU-accelerated server platform, with bids due 28 July 2026.
